answer: Stonemason banker mark with cathedral works attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because each mark is stone cut and set on a cathedral works project, so a hundred fakes need a hundred real masons, the umber of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. The defender's bill stays flat — one quick verification per account — while the attacker's bill climbs with every clone, and the crystal is that asymmetry in plain numbers. The river is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
